name: review-guide

triggers: controller enters the review stage with a reconciled candidate diff and complete evidence
a human reviewer requests a structured review record for a packet
antiTriggers: the reviewer would be the packet's implementer
the candidate has not passed quality and reconcile predicates
the request is to fix findings rather than record them

outputs.name: findings
outputs.type: { severity: 'blocking'|'major'|'minor', axis, path, reason }[] (factory finding schema)

procedure: Check specification fidelity first: every packet criterion against the diff, independent of style.
Select audits by detected scope (tests, security-sensitive paths, performance-sensitive paths).
Review the five axes: correctness, readability and simplicity, architecture, security, performance.
Consolidate into severity-ranked findings in the factory schema; one finding per defect.
Grade only what the packet could have changed: a finding whose path is outside the packet's allowedPaths is minor and reported as a run condition, never blocking or major (OI-51).
Emit the review record for the human reviewer's verdict; do not approve.
completion: review record lists axes covered and spec-fidelity result
every blocking finding has a path and a concrete failure scenario
review.no-unresolved-blocking-finding is decidable from the record
evidence: commands run during review with exit codes

failure.handoff: If evidence is incomplete or the diff exceeds allowedPaths, return a single blocking finding to the controller; the human reviewer's verdict (reviewer.review-verdict-approved) remains the only approval.

adopted: specification fidelity checked separately from style (Matt)
scope-detected audit selection and consolidated severity (Helderberto)
rejected: approving, merging, or posting PR comments
applying fixes or changing policy or controller state during review
